name: Fra'Mani Sweet Apple Ham
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Not surprisingly, this Sweet Apple Ham is tender & delicious. It pairs a touch of smoke with the subtle flavors of apple juice. It is hand trimmed with a delicious layer of cover fat that gives is an unforgettable luscious taste. Perfect for sandwiches & all your other roasted ham needs!

name: Rovagnati Mortadella
description: In the ancient days of "waste not want not," mortadella was born. While originally made using leftovers and whatever was available, today Rovagnati uses only prime cuts of pork shoulder, leg, and belly. This Italian Mortadella is the real deal, no mystery meat. It is flecked with pistachios, sliced thin and ready for your antipasti platter or sandwich.

name: Braceri Ham with Herbs
description: Braceri cooked ham with herbs is made in the ancient village of Lavezzola in Italy's Emilia-Romagna region. Lavezzola has always embodied a long-standing bond between food and landscape and is famous for traditional Italian charcuterie. Slow cooked for up to 17 hours, it is covered with a bouquet of fennel, rosemary, coriander, clove, anise, and caraway. Staff favorite next-level ham!

name: Carnegie Deli Pastrami
description: This is the most famous deli meat from the most famous deli in NYC. If you have been, you know. If you haven't, imagine a tower of warm pastrami aloft what amounts to be two diminutive pieces of rye bread. Too much for you? Not to worry - when you have this pastrami at home, you can make the sandwich any way you want! Add a few slices of emmenthaler, some grainy mustard and a pickle and save yourself the cost of airfare!

name: Columbus Roasted Turkey
description: Columbus Craft Meats is an artisan deli and cured meat company that takes great pride in using only the best ingredients.  In that vein, this is plain, all natural, oven roasted turkey.  No fillers, no forming, and no additives or preservatives.  It is lightly seasoned and then slow-roasted in the oven for a juicy, satisfying flavor. It tastes like...turkey.  The same turkey we used every day to make one of our most popular cafe sandwiches, the Tacchino.

name: Fra'Mani Mortadella
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salume products since 2006. Mortadella is not bologna, it is what bologna aspires to be. Fra' Mani uses only prime cuts of pork shoulder, leg, and belly that is meticulously hand-trimmed and minced. After slow roasting, it's finished with a light fruitwood smoke. We slice this thin, ready for your antipasti platter or sandwich. Natural nitrates.

name: Jack Mountain Smoked Ham
tagline: Slow smoked artisan ham from Burlington, WA!
description: Jack Mountain Meats, our neighbors to the North up in Burlington, WA, is an artisan food company dedicated to locally sourced, handcrafted, quality food. They utilize modern equipment and technology while maintaining old fashioned, handcrafted techniques. Their hams are selected each week, carefully trimmed then brined with their own in-house spice blends and rubbed with thyme and garlic. After resting for three days, they are smoked all day over hazelnut shells. The result is a delicious, savory ham you will absolutely love.

name: Jambon de Paris
description: Bec Fin's Jambon de Paris is slow-cooked to maintain its natural juices and flavor. The result is a far less salty, moist and tender French-style cooked ham. Perfect on a baguette with Comte and cornichons, or in an omelet or quiche.

name: Leoncini Prosciutto Cotto
description: Leoncini's Prosciutto Cotto is gently brined before being slow roasted to perfection, preserving all the natural juices and flavors of the ham. Delicate in texture and bright pink in color, it is well marbled and flavorful. Great for antipasti and sandwiches.

name: Molinari Finocchiona Salame
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Finocchiona Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with fennel. Finely minced in texture, sweet and flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured salame with black pepper
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame - 12oz Piece
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, 12 oz whole
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! In its whole form, great to cut by hand a little bit, or a lot at a time!

description:

name: Molinari Toscano Salame
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Toscano Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with whole black peppercorns. Coarsely ground in texture, tangy and flavorful. A DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Taylor Pork Roll, 1lb
description: Taylor Ham, AKA Taylor Pork Roll, was developed in 1856 by John Taylor of Trenton, New Jersey. Springsteen and Taylor Ham - easily the two best things to come out of New Jersey. Don't knock it until you try it! Here's what you do: slice it up, and make a few cuts around the outside edge to keep it flat during cooking. Pan fry until light brown and enjoy! Combine it with a fried egg and cheese on a soft kaiser roll for the ultimate Jersey breakfast sandwich!

name: Tempesta 'Ndujadella
description: Tempesta Artisan Salumi’s latest innovation! After over two years of research and development, Tempesta brings together the savory slice-ability of their award-winning Mortadella with the fire of their heritage ‘Nduja! ‘Ndujadella is their Mortadella, made as you would only find made by craftsmen in Bologna, infused with Calabrian fire. They fold their aged ‘Nduja directly into the emulsion! The traditional garnishes of black peppercorns and pistachios have been replaced with the skins of Calabrian chilies. A truly unique charcuterie offering, the texture is yielding, but sliceable. The signature heat and fruity aroma of the Calabrian chilies is bold, while gaining depth over the course of aging as ‘nduja. The cooked fat of the mortadella lends a richness that fills the palate with savory flavor. Unique offering as a piccante addition to any charcuterie board or a mind-blowing addition to any sandwich. One taste and you’ll be hooked!

name: Tempesta Wagyu Pastrami
tagline: Yes, this is made with Wagyu Beef!
description: There is pastrami, and then there is PASTRAMI. This is capital letter pastrami. Tempesta's version is made with American Wagyu Beef that has been seasoned in a flavorful brine for days before getting rubbed in molasses and spices. Next it is slow smoked and cooked in sessions with maple wood. Incredibly tender and delicious, it will take your game-day Reuben to the next level!

name: Zoe's Meats Roast Beef
description: Marinated using their house blend of garlic, herbs, and spices, Zoe's Roast Beef is tender, juicy, and intensely flavored. It makes a daily appearance in our cafe on one of our most popular sandwiches, the Arrosto - a combination of roast beef, reserve Gruyere, arugula and truffle mayonnaise. Also highly recommended for the next time French Dip is on the menu.
